correctness.rationale: Probability normalization on the characters of the additive group R² gives the squared sum of ordered pair amplitudes with no additional factor. The radical is an F-vector space even without a coefficient field; the inverse on a fiber is u⁻¹−a⁻²v. Nonzero residue sum determines the unordered pair by its sum and product. Distinct non-antipodal residues give an invertible two-block map and hence 4B_aB_b; repeated residues give self-convolution. For antipodal residues the second sum is −a⁻² times the first, so different pairs mix only at the actual origin. Adding the amplitudes there gives precisely the cross term 8 Re(P_a(0) overline(P_b(0))) for distinct opposite pairs. Subtracting yields the stated deficit, whose terms are nonnegative by Fourier Parseval and Cauchy–Schwarz. Since Q≥3, strict positivity of 3Q−6 confines equality to one pair, and its imbalance term forces equal nonzero masses. Equality in self-convolution concentrates Fourier mass at one radical character; equality in the mixed convolution forces the two characters to coincide. These packets give zero deficit and have one relative phase after nonzero complex scaling, yielding Q(q−1)/2 circles. The sharp fourth-power coefficient is 3Q/2, not the operator norm itself. Fresh exact checks covered all 729 signed ternary inputs on Z/9, 240 Gaussian-integer arrays on Z/25, and one relative-phase-i equality packet; Z/25 exercises interference between two different antipodal pairs.

value.rationale: For a natural inverse graph beyond the field case, the exact norm and complete packet classification show how radical size and antipodal collisions determine optimal Fourier concentration. The common actual zero fiber is a meaningful obstruction to extrapolating from an indicator energy or independent residue classes. The all-ring exact deficit quantifies separate losses from spectral dispersion, mass imbalance, and leakage. It is useful across nonsplit and split rings, not a recomputation of a single finite case.
residual_risks: No claim about characteristic two, nonlocal rings, higher nilpotency, or other exponents is needed or established.
